versions.changelog: Reworked commuter-to-workplace matching to reproduce census commute totals exactly and even out block-to-block variation; recomputed map geometry in the map's local projection for a lighter download and wider default view.
Full modeling refresh — per-building foundation depth, Global Building Atlas heights, fuller land use, and greatly expanded cultural and entertainment demand; metropolitan boundary widened.
Initial release of the Okayama map with census-based residents and workers, commute demand, and university, zoo, aquarium, and school demand.
